scope: Agency Agent routing and optional installed-profile proof only; no application tests or runtime agent execution

checks.focus: Prove compatible pinned dependencies and the smallest strict build scaffold; do not redesign the stack or implement business features.
Local PostgreSQL/environment/readiness/CI foundation and isolated failure checks; no authentication or business CRUD.
Implement the accepted Better Auth/MFA/session policy; inspect direct-request authorization, secret handling, and recovery/revocation evidence.
Implement only the approved Arabic RTL shell/PWA and real state behavior; test keyboard/reflow and prevent confidential caches.
Party/identity/POA metadata and shared audit/idempotency; examine encryption-key handling, version conflicts, and actual isolated tests.
Matter/Proceeding/party relations, reference settings and migrations; preserve same-matter constraints and validate real PostgreSQL behavior.
Normalized bounded search and archive behavior using the approved Arabic screens and failure cases; no document-content search.
Atomic hearing result/next hearing/tasks/outbox plus usable mobile failure/retry states; no premature reminder worker.
Manual deadline confirmation, tasks and Cairo agenda states; never invent legal periods, dates, or completion evidence.
Durable PostgreSQL reminder jobs/leases/retries and worker failure evidence; no Redis, external delivery promises, or extra infrastructure.
Private upload/finalization/scanning and authorized preview; inspect fail-closed validation and real negative cases.
Immutable document versions, authorized metadata search/links and backup-safe cleanup without public exposure.
Exact EGP piastres, balanced fee posting/allocation/receipts and transactional concurrency; no tax or legal-revenue claims.
Separate reimbursable expenses, office costs and advances with locked balance checks and independent expected outcomes.
Full correction reversals and allocation release; preserve immutable history and prevent duplicate actual cash effects.
Actual partial/full refunds and fee adjustments with capacity/locking tests; do not substitute reversal for disbursement.
Multi-client distribution, reconciled statements and restricted opening positions; no floating balances or fabricated history.
Generate the planned HTML/Playwright Arabic PDFs and private CSV/ZIP exports; inspect layout, totals, authorization and formula injection without changing stacks.
The accepted limited import template, clear Arabic preview and persistent replay/source-link checks; no universal migration engine.
Pinned private deployment configuration and isolated fault checks; no service purchase or live deployment without the existing explicit operational assignment.
Coordinate dump/files/manifest/key backup and clean restore drills with measured evidence; do not add HA, replication or PITR.
Observe the real lawyer pilot and record actual usability/accessibility findings; do not invent user participation, self-approve, or expand the UI.
Use accepted migration/opening commands and approved cutover/recovery gates; prepare the Arabic handover and reconcile actual authorized results.

installedProfileChecks: NOT RUN: use -VerifyInstalled on the implementation machine
antigravityRuntimeExecution: NOT RUN: native definitions and required invocation policy are statically checked, not executed in Antigravity
projectSkills: Validated separately by Validate-AntigravityKit.ps1; Agency profiles do not replace the seven project skills
